@graph.name: GFC Hair Treatment
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions - Best Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) Treatment in Bangalore - Marathahalli - Whitefield. Affordable. Sr Dermatologist. Book Appointment
@graph.howPerformed: A small amount of blood is drawn from your arm and processed in a centrifuge to extract highly concentrated growth factors. The GFC is then injected into the scalp or skin with micro-needling or targeted injections. The growth factors stimulate cell regeneration, improving hair density or skin texture over time.

acceptedAnswer.text: The procedure involves minimal discomfort, and numbing agents are used to keep you comfortable.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, 3–6 sessions are recommended, depending on your condition.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Improvements can often be seen in 4–6 weeks, with full results developing over 3–6 months.

mainEntity.name: What should I do before and after GFC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoid alcohol and smoking for 48 hours beforehand. Afterwards, avoid direct sun for 24–48 hours and don't wash the treated area for at least 6 hours.
